BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring a balanced legislative budget; andamending RCW 43.88.080.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.88.080 and 1973 1st ex.s. c 100 s 5 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Adoption of the omnibus appropriation bill or bills by thelegislature shall constitute adoption of the budget and the making ofappropriations therefor. A budget for state government shall befinally adopted not later than thirty calendar days prior to thebeginning of the ensuing biennium. The legislature may not appropriatean amount from any account for any fiscal period that is in excess ofthe estimated amount of revenues and resources to that account for thatfiscal period as of the date the budget is adopted.
